title: Behavior Facet -- behaviors.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §9, SDD-R005. Declarative metadata only -- no executable solver implementation (SDD-R005 §11: "The implementation language is intentionally unspecified"; the Engineering Behavior Engine that would execute these is out of scope for this repository). As of WORK_PACKAGE_002 (REFERENCE-TASK-000015): behavior_type uses SDD-R011 §9's nine-value list, replacing SDD-R005 §5's twelve-value list; `description` is explicitly documentation only, separate from the executable contract (inputs/outputs/constraints/dependencies); `execution_metadata` records facts about execution without performing it. Behavior identifiers describe engineering intent (verb phrases), not arbitrary codes.

description.description: Documentation only (SDD-R011 §9: "Behavior descriptions are documentation") -- never a substitute for the structured inputs/outputs/constraints below.

constraints.description: REFERENCE-TASK-000014 structured pre/post-conditions (SDD-R005 §8), replacing WORK_PACKAGE_001's free-text constraint strings.

dependencies.description: SDD-R005 §10 -- Object IDs this behavior's calculation depends upon.

execution_metadata.description: SDD-R011 §9. Facts describing execution (e.g. deterministic, complexity) without performing it -- no executable code lives here.

unit_symbol_pending.description: See properties.schema.json -- same documented, temporary escape hatch (REFERENCE-TASK-000011).
